entities.summary: Travis Fulton was an American mixed martial artist and a professional boxer in the heavyweight division of both sports. Known as a longtime veteran in mixed martial arts, he competed in over 300 sanctioned bouts and while he was perhaps best known for competing in smaller US-based promotions, he also competed in the UFC, the USWF, the WEC, Pancrase, M-1 Global, the Chicago Red Bears of the IFL, King of the Cage, RINGS, and Oktagon MMA. He also holds the record for the most sanctioned mixed martial arts bouts, with 320 bouts; in addition to that, he also holds the most wins in mixed martial arts history (255).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a veteran mixed martial artist with over 300 sanctioned bouts and 255 wins, Travis Fulton holds records in both sports, contributing to the growth of MMA as a legitimate combat sport. His longevity and achievements paved the way for future generations of fighters.
